metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_collapse_score: Mean off-diagonal cosine among nonzero vectors sampled from up to 2048 nonpadding item embeddings, mapped by (cos+1)/2. About 0.5 indicates mean cosine near zero; larger values indicate directional alignment. This alone does not measure effective dimension, recommendation diversity, or user preferences.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative logit over observed positions with distinct nonpadding candidates; scale dependent.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank lower 10th percentile of those margins; scale dependent.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of measured positions with negative logit strictly above positive logit; ties are excluded from this rate.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of measured positions with positive-minus-negative logit below 0.5; scale dependent.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_num_positio: Number of measured training positions; zero means no eligible margin evidence.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_category_br: Position counts at margin thresholds; item-category lists remain empty because categories are unavailable.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:paired_rank_sensitivity: Descriptive evaluation-mode interventions on at most 16 contiguous, left-padded training rows with at least seven input items. Rows may repeat users; distinct user counts are unmeasured. For each row, the last positive target and up to 31 unique supplied training negatives excluding input history are held fixed across all interventions. Zero-based target rank uses average ties and is divided by candidate_count-1; smaller ranks are better. Comparisons report mean normalized rank change and fraction with worsening rank. Recent deletion removes up to four items immediately before the final input item; older deletion removes an equal number of oldest input items. Both compact and left-pad the surviving history, so positional shifts also contribute. Shuffling permutes the four items preceding the final input item while preserving membership and the final item. These interventions can create distribution shift; they do not establish causal user preferences. This is not pinned validation HR@10 and must not select configurations.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:evidence_availability: Explicit evidence boundaries; unavailable attributes and simulator traits must not be inferred as observations.
